calls.command:
git add src/click/exceptions.py tests/test_formatting.py && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Fix help option hint when subcommand shadows help option names

When a subcommand defines an option that reuses one of the group's configured help option names, the usage error hint would suggest a shadowed help option that's actually unusable on that subcommand.

This fix:
1. Uses get_help_option_names() to get only the available (non-shadowed) help option names
2. Prefers the longest available name for better UX
3. Shows no hint if all help option names are shadowed

Fixes the hint to only reference help option names that are actually available on the command.
Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
